lead.description: the choice of which measured predictors enter a fitted model, with the others left out

self_checks.title: Intercept-only residual sum of squares
self_checks.prompt: For the cases (x, z, y) = (0, 0, 1), (1, 0, 1) and (2, 1, 3), what is the residual sum of squares of the intercept-only fit?
self_checks.answer: The residual sum of squares is 8/3.

self_checks.title: Predictor x alone
self_checks.prompt: On the same three cases, what is the residual sum of squares of the least-squares line that uses only x and an intercept?
self_checks.answer: The residual sum of squares is 2/3.

self_checks.title: How many best-subset models
self_checks.prompt: Best-subset selection with 20 predictors fits how many models, and forward stepwise fits how many?
self_checks.answer: Best subset fits 1048576 models. Forward stepwise fits 211.

overview_sentence: [Feature selection](articles/feature-selection.qmd) decides which predictors enter a fitted model and leaves the others out.
